fusions.name: Trampling Heel
fusions.desc: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Column Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds. A troop escort marches beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Road-Hardened Knuckles
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
